mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth falls below 0.5% annually, supply constraints drive inflation and policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% triggers anticipated Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and fall in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS does not produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts growth below 0.2% annually indicates a weakening housing sector, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST growth < 0.2%.
